title: Telemetry: plumb `route` through request context + metering events
author: Nadia Rahman
description:
Problem: Usage Insights needs a first-class `route` dimension to attribute cost/latency to developer-defined endpoints. Today we can derive some “route-ish” grouping in the gateway logs, but metering events emitted by the runtime don’t carry a stable route identifier, so we can’t build consistent cost-by-route aggregates across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

This PR adds `route` to the request context and plumbs it through to metering events (token metering + request summary), while staying backwards compatible with older consumers.

What’s included: 1) Request context: adds `route` to `RequestContext` and threads it through gateway -> router -> runtime request envelope. Route is populated from (in order): (a) explicit SDK/header value `X-Redwood-Route` (preferred), (b) gateway-derived route template (best-effort), (c) fallback `unknown`.

2) Metering event schema: adds optional `route` field to `TokenMeteringEvent` and `RequestSummaryEvent` (schema v2). The event emitter writes both v1 and v2 for now (dual-write) to avoid breaking downstream pipelines.

3) Minimal normalization/guardrails in the hot path: enforces max length (128) and trims whitespace; does NOT do full normalization/hashing here (see ADR / follow-up). If the header value fails basic validation, we drop it and emit `unknown` while incrementing a counter.

4) Tests: unit tests for route extraction precedence and validation; integration test verifying metering events include the route when provided; regression test to ensure older consumers can still parse v1 events.

Migration notes: - New header supported immediately: `X-Redwood-Route: <string>`. SDK ergonomics will land in follow-up PRs (ENG-8432). - Downstream consumers should read `route` from schema v2 when present; v1 remains available during the migration window. - Expect some percentage of traffic to show up as `unknown` until customers tag routes in SDKs/gateways.

Rollout plan: guarded behind feature flag `telemetry.route_dimension` (default off). We’ll enable in staging + internal dogfood orgs first, then roll out by environment.

Out of scope: full normalization rules (allowed chars, canonicalization) and cardinality rollups; those are handled by the route normalization layer/ADR and the aggregation pipeline work (ENG-8422).

Screenshots/recordings: N/A (backend-only).

Testing: `bazel test //services/gateway/... //services/metering/...`, `go test ./...` in metering package, staging canary validated via metering debug topic.

Docs: none in this PR (DevEx/docs tracked separately).
commits: gateway: extract route from header and attach to RequestContext
router/runtime: thread route through internal request envelope
metering: add route to v2 token metering + request summary events (dual-write)
tests: route precedence/validation + metering serialization regression
review_conversation:
Logan Wright (review): Good direction. Two asks: (1) please add a hard length limit on the header value in the gateway (we should not accept arbitrarily long strings into the request context), and (2) ensure we’re not accidentally logging raw route values anywhere in error logs.

Nadia Rahman (author): Added max length 128 and trimmed whitespace; invalid values drop to `unknown` with a counter. Also audited logs: route is not included in error logs; only emitted in metering events.

Thomas Baird (review): Can we avoid doing any heavy normalization here? Also please add a metric for “route_invalid_total” and “route_missing_total” so we can monitor adoption.

Nadia Rahman (author): Agreed—kept hot-path normalization minimal (trim + length). Added `telemetry_route_invalid_total` and `telemetry_route_missing_total` counters, tagged by environment.

Caleb Johnson (review): For request summary events, confirm the route represents the original user request even if smart routing/model fallback occurs mid-request.

Nadia Rahman (author): Yes—route is sourced from RequestContext created at ingress and carried along; fallback changes model but not the route. Added a regression test to ensure route persists when `selected_model` changes.

Amara Diallo (review): Gateway-derived route template can be tricky. In this PR, can we keep it best-effort and prefer explicit SDK/header? Also document precedence in-code.

Nadia Rahman (author): Done; explicit header wins, then gateway template, then `unknown`. Added inline comment in extractor.

Final: approvals from Logan, Thomas, and Caleb after changes; merged via squash.
release_notes: Internal: adds optional `route` dimension to metering events (behind `telemetry.route_dimension` flag) to support upcoming Console Usage Insights cost-by-route views.
